comment: Recognition layer 2: community / district sign triggers. lat/lon are real-world OSM coordinates; road.project() converts them to world space at runtime. triggerRadius is in compressed-world metres (~0.3× real distance). Entries marked needs_owner_review: true require the owner's lived knowledge to confirm name, exact placement, or the one-line note — owner's knowledge is authoritative over map data.

communities.name: Palisadoes
communities.note: The narrow sand spit connecting the airport to Kingston — coconut trees and sea on both sides

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: The roundabout where the Palisadoes road meets Kingston — city straight ahead

communities.name: Rockfort
communities.note: Industrial community on Windward Road near the old fort ruins

communities.name: Rae Town
communities.note: Old Kingston Harbour fishing village — roots sound-system culture

communities.name: Cross Roads
communities.note: Kingston's gateway intersection between downtown and uptown

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: Uptown Kingston's commercial hub — named for the cotton tree that stood halfway to Spanish Town

communities.name: Six Miles
communities.note: Community on Spanish Town Road — six miles from downtown Kingston

communities.name: Spanish Town
communities.note: Former capital of Jamaica — founded by the Spanish in 1534, Jamaica's oldest city

communities.name: Sligoville
communities.note: First free village in Jamaica — established after Emancipation in 1838

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: Gateway to the Rio Cobre gorge — the name is a corruption of the Spanish 'boca del agua'

communities.name: Angels
communities.note: Small community inside the Bog Walk gorge

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: Market town of St. Catherine — immortalised in the folk song Linstead Market

communities.name: Ewarton
communities.note: Junction town in St. Catherine — Alcan alumina plant is nearby

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: Mountain crossroads between St. Catherine and St. Ann — cool breeze country

communities.name: Faith's Pen
communities.note: Legendary roadside cookshop strip — jerk chicken, roast yam and festival since the 1970s

communities.name: Claremont
communities.note: St. Ann hill town at the top of Fern Gully

communities.name: Fern Gully
communities.note: Three kilometres of road canopied by tree ferns — one of Jamaica's most iconic drives

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: Tourism capital of the north coast — you made it, brethren!
